top_signals.title: Chinese Chipmaker Longsys Seeks $800 Million in HK Listing
top_signals.summary: Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co. is seeking to raise as much as HK$6.28 billion ($801 million) in a Hong Kong listing, extending the wave of Chinese companies along the artificial intelligence supply chain coming to the market after its onshore shares have gained about 50% this year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Itochu set to take Dentsu Soken private in $1.3 billion deal
top_signals.summary: Itochu will acquire almost 75 million Dentsu Soken shares at ¥2,880 each, valuing the deal at roughly ¥215.2 billion.
